title: Oral History of Panel on the Development and Promotion of Fairchild Micrologic Integrated Circuits
lineage: 2007 participant timeline quotes excerpts from contemporaneous 1960 reports; complete original reports were not independently inspected. Nall evaluates the isolation approach, not necessarily the same physical flip-flop.
